title: pr-pane 0.3.2: /prs autoOpen survives a missing /config row
summary: Handle $.config.set rejecting, and fall back to options.autoOpen when the row is absent.
description: In a headless session (claude -p) with pr-pane installed from the catalog at v0.3.1, '/prs autoOpen enable|disable' reply 'no command.run hook answered it': $.config.set rejects a key no /config row has, and autoOpen() lets the rejection throw. The bare '/prs autoOpen' reads only the row, so with no row it reports 'off' whatever options.autoOpen holds. Reported by evolv-marketplace, who is holding catalog PR evolvconsulting/evolv-marketplace#22.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When $.config.set rejects, /prs autoOpen enable|disable answers that the setting is unchanged and names /plugin configure as the way to change it
With no pr-pane.autoOpen row, the bare /prs autoOpen reports options.autoOpen and says the value came from the plugin options rather than /config
Tests cover a rejecting $.config.set and an absent row; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1/AC2: live 'claude -p --plugin-dir plugin' on fix/pr-pane-0.3.2: bare /prs autoOpen answered 'Auto-open is on ... from the plugin's options (this session has no /config row for it)'; enable and disable answered 'Auto-open is unchanged ... claude plugin configure pr-pane'; ~/.claude/settings.json unchanged.

AC3: tests '/prs autoOpen without a /config row reports the options and changes nothing' and '/prs autoOpen reports a rejected write instead of failing'; 25/25 (x3), validate --strict, tsc 0 errors, CI run 39298092570 passed on PR #5.
Open until shipped: complete after PR #5 merges and v0.3.2 is tagged.
Distribution (checked against GitHub on 2026-10-20): v0.3.2 entered the catalog through evolv-marketplace#23 (aa8a813). The org library was republished from a clean v0.3.2 checkout.
finalSummary: Shipped pr-pane 0.3.2 (PR #5, squash 05e0cdc, tag v0.3.2, GitHub release). In a session with no pr-pane.autoOpen /config row (headless -p), /prs autoOpen now reports options.autoOpen as the source, and enable/disable answer 'unchanged' and point to 'claude plugin configure pr-pane' instead of throwing. Rejections from $.config.set and $.config.list are caught. Verified by 25/25 tests (new: absent row, rejecting set), validate --strict, tsc and CI; a live claude -p run of all three forms; and Jeremy's interactive bare /prs autoOpen reading the row. The tag went to evolv-marketplace, which skipped 0.3.1 and bumps v0.3.0 -> v0.3.2.
